AbsenceReason.description: A reason for an absence. (The schema name `Reason` is taken by the choice of club and team.)

hidden.description: Not offered for new absences; still shown on old ones.

from.description: "In the team from": the first day of their roles in this season.

players.description: Players of last season to bring into this season ("Add all" sends all of them).

start_time.description: Dutch local start time, for example "13:00"; `null` when it is not known.

from.description: The first day of the new role; the current role ends on the day before.

ChangeView.description: A change from the game as the coordinator last saw it to the game now.

oneOf.description: The game now; `null` for a game no longer in the game list.
The game as last seen; `null` for a new game.

differences.description:
Every difference of a `moved`, `start_time_known`, `home_and_away` or `team_changed`
change; empty for the other kinds.

reason.description: Now, or as last seen when the game is no longer in the schedule.

version.description: Send it back with "seen": a change that a reading updated meanwhile stays.

changes.description: Empty unless a team is chosen for the current season. In the order of the games.

teams.description: The club's own teams in the current season; empty when the season has no games yet.

town.description: `null` when the source has no town for the club.

CountsView.description: How many changes of each kind a reading found, only for games in the schedule.

HistoryRole.description: A role in a player's history.

correctable.description: Only a role of the current season can be corrected.

season.description: The season of the role, for example "2026-2027".

until.description: The last day; `null` while the role continues.

HoldView.description: Why a reading was held back: `now` games instead of `before`.

LastChoice.description: The choice of an earlier season.

LatestReadings.description: The newest reading and the last good reading of the current club and season.

oneOf.description:
The held-back reading the coordinator can confirm: the newest reading that did not fail,
when it is held back. A failed reading after it does not hide it.

out_of_date_since.description:
The time of the last good reading, when 3 nightly run moments passed without a good
reading: the games may be out of date since then. `null` without a chosen team.

from.description: "Not in the team from": the first day without the team.

removes.description:
The ids of the roles the coordinator confirmed to remove (roles that start on `from` or
later); empty at first.

LeftTeam.description: The answer of "Remove from the team".

MemberView.description: A player in a group of the team page, with a role.

last_day_today.description:
In the team, and today is the last day: the role today ends today, no role follows, and
today is not the last day of the season. The row shows "Last day today".

role.description:
Today's role (or the coming one); in "left", the last role of the season; in
"last_season", the last role of last season.

roles.description: The roles of the season shown (last season's for "last_season").

hidden.description: A hidden player is not offered in "Add player" of the team page and not in "Add all".

PlayerDetail.description: One player with the history of all seasons.

history.description: All roles of all seasons, newest first.

season_first_day.description: The first day of the current season: the earliest date of a corrected role.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the current season: the latest date of a corrected role.

PlayerListItem.description: A player in the list of all players.

oneOf.description: The role today; `null` when the player is not in the team today.

PlayersList.description: All players of the club, sorted by first name.

ReadingView.description: One reading of the game list. A failed or held-back reading is a result, not an HTTP error.

oneOf.description: `null` for the first reading, and for a failed or held-back reading.

first_reading.description: The first reading after a choice of club or team: it counts nothing.

games_read.description: The number of games read; `null` for a failed reading.

Reason.description: Why a team must be chosen.

Refusal.description: The body of a refused request: the code, with details for some codes.

date.description: For `role_starts_later`: the start of the player's later role, for example "2026-11-02".

roles.description: For `confirm_removal`: the roles "Remove from the team" would remove, in order of start.

RoleDatesView.description: A role without its id, as "Undo" sends it back.

RoleView.description: A role of a player in the team of a season.

until.description: The last day; `null` while the role continues.

team.description: The source's team number; leave it out only when the season has no games yet.

SavedPlayer.description: A saved player, with the warning that another player has the same name.

oneOf.description: `null`: no club is chosen, or a team is needed and no earlier season had one.

home.description: Full team names, with the club name in front.

in_list.description: False: the game is no longer in the game list; it shows until its change is seen.

start_time.description: Dutch local start time, for example "13:00"; `null` when it is not known yet.

coming.description: Today (Dutch date) and later, in time order.

last_season.description:
True: a new season started and its team is not chosen yet; these are the games of the
team of the newest earlier season.

past.description: Before today, newest date first, in time order within a date.

season.description: The season of the games, for example "2026-2027".

unseen_changes.description: The number of changes not seen yet (`GET /api/changes`); 0 for last season's schedule.

open.description: The number of changes not seen yet after this.

oneOf.description: The choice of the newest earlier season, if any (for example last season's team).

Selection.description: The state of the choice. `season` is always the current season.

TeamPageView.description: The team of the current season.

candidates.description:
The players "Add player" offers: not hidden and not in the team this season; last season's
team first.

last_season.description:
Players who were in the team until the end of last season, have no role in this season and
are not hidden: "Add all" brings them back. Empty as soon as one player of last season's
team has a role in this season.

left.description: Players with a role earlier in the season and none today or later.

members.description: Players with a role today or later in the season, sorted by first name.

proposed_from.description: The proposed "In the team from" of "Add player" and "Add all": 1 September of the season.

season_first_day.description: The first day of the season, for example "2026-07-01": the earliest date of a role.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the season, for example "2027-06-30": the latest date of a role.

team_name.description:
The name of the team chosen from the game list for the season, for example "U14-1";
`null` while no team is chosen.

today.description: Today's Dutch date: the proposed date of "Change role" and "Remove from the team".

UndoRemoval.description:
What "Undo" sends back after "Remove from the team": the date of the removal and the
player's roles of the season from before it.

WeeklyTrainingInput.description: A new or changed weekly training.

WeeklyTrainingView.description: A weekly training: a day of the week with its times, in a window.

from.description: The first day of the window, for example "2026-09-01".

until.description: The last day of the window.

WeeklyTrainings.description: The weekly trainings of the current season, sorted by the start of the window.

season_first_day.description: The first day of the season, for example "2026-07-01": the earliest date of a window.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the season, for example "2027-06-30": the latest date of a window.

WindowProposal.description: The proposed window of a weekly training.
